name: lpqi_r10000
label: LPQI R = 10 000 spectrograph, 400-950 nm
sources: F. Prada, 2026-10-09 (via P. Nugent): the final LPQI instrument disperses 400-950 nm at R ~ 10 000 onto the microlensed IMSE-LPQI array
notes: Constant lambda/dlambda = 10 000: 8650 channels of 0.040 nm (blue end) to 0.095 nm (red end).
Throughput 0.5 = DISPERSED_THROUGHPUT (spectrograph + coupling optics, the EON-SII convention); the telescope file carries the rest.
